results.note: Asserts that when the fetcher returns Unavailable, run_ingestion does not send the plain success ping to HEARTBEAT_URL — only the explicit /fail ping fires (events == ['persisted', 'ping:.../fail']). ingest/heartbeat.py:54-58 implements this: it raises RuntimeError when fetch_result.status is not OK/STALE, which is caught and routed to the failure ping rather than the silent success signal.

Persist raising RuntimeError('database write failed') is asserted to still propagate to the caller while producing exactly one request to '{HEARTBEAT_URL}/fail' — ingest/heartbeat.py:56-58 pings failed=True in the except block before re-raising, giving failure a distinct signal from silence (no ping call at all if the process crashed before this point).

Client transport raises httpx.ConnectError on every ping; test asserts run_ingestion still returns row_id 42 without raising. ingest/heartbeat.py:23-32 (_ping) catches httpx.HTTPError and swallows it, so a broken monitor cannot fail or block the ingestion run.
